result.plan:
{"how": "1. Gather resources:
   • Wood logs or sticks
   • Stone or metal ore
   • Flint or fire source
   
2. Prepare materials:
   • Shape the wooden handle using a knife or saw.
   • Smelt iron ore into ingots if you have smelting capability; otherwise use raw stone.
   
3. Forge the blade:
   • Heat the metal until it glows red.
   • Hammer onto a flat surface to shape into a sharp edge.
   
4. Attach blade to handle:
   • Apply adhesive or bind tightly with rope/wire.
   
5. Harden the blade:
   • Reheat then quench quickly in water or oil.
   
6. Polish and test:
   • Sharpen edges further if necessary.
   
7. Store safely.", "what": "A functional axe ready for chopping tasks", "why": "Combines basic blacksmithing techniques suitable for most survival scenarios"}
